facts.fact: Burkina Faso's national AI roadmap 2026-2030 was validated on 19 June 2026 after ten months of work, and its official publication is still awaited, according to Dr Yaya Traore of the digital-transition ministry.

note: No body named for carrying it out (an AI Council is only envisaged) and the FCFA 30 billion budget is projected, not allocated.
